info.title: Hedra API v2 (Legacy)
info.description: The v2 generations API. New integrations should use the [Hedra API](https://api.hedra.com/v3), which reaches every image, video, and audio model through a single submit-and-poll surface. v2 remains supported for existing integrations.

get.description: Retrieve your uploaded and generated assets by asset type, with optional filtering by IDs.

post.description: Create a new asset record before uploading a supported file to use in generations.
Upload the file contents for a previously created asset.

get.description: Retrieve the current API credit balance for your account.
Retrieve a paginated list of your generations, with optional filtering by type, date, or prompt.

post.description: Start a new image, video, or audio generation using your chosen model and inputs.

get.description: Check the status of a generation and retrieve the resulting asset when it completes.
Retrieve the list of AI models available through the Hedra API, including image, video, and audio generation models.
Retrieve the list of text-to-speech voices available for audio generation and avatar videos.
